content:
Apple's lineup of upcoming products this fall includes the Apple Watch Series 12. Below are the four rumored new features expected from this year's Apple Watch update.

#1: A brand-new chip (a real upgrade)

The Apple Watch Series 9, 10, and 11 all basically run on the same chip. However, according to rumors, this year's Apple Watch Series 12 will receive a genuine chip upgrade.

Macworld reported on the change:

The 2026 model was identified as "Watch8," suggesting a significant hardware leap. For instance, the Apple Watch Series 9, Series 10, and Series 11 all fall under the "Watch7" lineup due to their similar specifications. The "Watch8" lineup includes the N237, N238, and N240 models (the Apple Watch Series 12 with GPS and cellular, and the Ultra 4, respectively), which will feature the all-new T8320 processor.

The last time Apple introduced a truly new processor to the Apple Watch was with the launch of the Apple Watch Series 9 in 2023. That upgrade brought faster CPU and GPU performance.

As Apple brings Siri AI features to the Apple Watch with watchOS 27, a performance boost will be key for future AI capabilities.

#2: Battery life

Battery life is reportedly one of the key improvements for this year's Apple Watch Series 12. It is said that Apple is working on increasing the actual battery capacity while also improving energy efficiency in other areas.

As Apple continues to push sleep tracking and other Apple Watch features, extending battery life has become a major priority for the company.

#3: All-new health features

According to Digitimes, Apple has submitted a brand-new hypertension notification feature to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for review.

watchOS 26 added hypertension notification features to the Apple Watch for the first time. It remains unclear how this rumored new feature will differ from the existing version.

The existing Apple Watch hypertension feature does not actually provide blood pressure readings; instead, it uses data collected by the heart rate sensor to notify users when a "hypertensive pattern" is detected over a 30-day evaluation period.

Whether the Apple Watch Series 12 will bring other health feature upgrades remains to be seen. Apple is still working on a non-invasive blood glucose monitoring feature for the Apple Watch, but that technology is still years away from maturity.

#4: All-new watch faces

According to Bloomberg, Apple is developing a brand-new Apple Watch face described as a "simplified version of the Modular Ultra design."

This new face is essentially a streamlined version of the popular Modular Ultra face from the Apple Watch Ultra, tailored for the standard "Series" models.

This new modular face is expected to support other Apple Watch models, though it is widely expected to make its official debut at the Apple Watch Series 12 launch event.

Bonus: Features not to look forward to

Although there were once rumors that the Apple Watch Series 12 might add Touch ID support, it now appears that this feature will not be coming.

Instead, more recent rumors suggest that Apple decided to shelve the feature after evaluation, concluding that adding new health features and increasing battery capacity are more important for the Apple Watch.

Summary of Apple Watch Series 12 new features

The Apple Watch Series 12 is expected to be released in September alongside the Apple Watch Ultra 4.

Which new Apple Watch feature are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments.
